summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 to furnish a press release announcing a $6 million purchase order under a Master Services Agreement IDIQ contract with a major U.S. municipality. The multi-year agreement covers consulting services with a base term of three years plus two one-year options. The filing also notes a total backlog of $112 million. No special situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine material event press release without strategic corporate change implications.
